Patrolling up Queen Street with checks on stores and businesses.
Welfare check on Remedy Coffee, all clear.

Arrived at bottom of Fort Street; welfare check on Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience, Chargrills and other stores.
Response call from Vape Haven Fort Street: the same individual from yesterday is inside the store harassing staff.
Arrived; asked the POI to leave, he complied. Given a verbal trespass and a written trespass warning (captured on bodycam). Standby — POI still lingering in the area.

Continuing patrols; welfare checks along the rest of High Street stores, all clear.

Welfare check on Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare checks along Lorne Street stores and businesses.

Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check along Nandos and Munster Inn, all clear.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, no issues.

Welfare check along Mr Barber, City Convenience plus and AA Insurance, all clear.

Arrived at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.

Morning shift concluded; lunch break completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift — Team 2 (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
HOTC Safety Team guards: Henry / Brent (14:30 – 22:30).
Debrief with morning shift complete, no issues.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart. Standby showing presence.
Commencing patrols up Albert St, heading to Aotea.

While en route to Aotea, response call from Puffing Kiwi: male vagrant publicly urinating in front of the store. Investigated with the manager; caught up with the male and warned him against public urination (risk of arrest for public indecency). The male moved on to a different location.
Response call from 102 Albert Street: two vagrants drinking alcohol at the front of their store. Spoke to the two vagrants; they complied without issues and moved down Lower Queen.
Observed a male drinking alcohol heading down Victoria Street East; approached him and told him to dispose of the alcohol, which he complied with and left without further issues.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (9%).
Heading to Aotea for full sweep.
Arrived at Aotea, no issues. Heading towards Federal Street.
Arrived at Federal Street, no problems. Commencing patrols heading to Wyndham Street.
Arrived at Wyndham Street, no issues. Heading down Lower Albert St.
Arrived at Lower Albert St, no issues. Heading to HQ for floor checks.

Response call from 102 Albert Street: vagrants smoking and drinking alcohol. On arrival one male was sitting outside smoking some sort of substance; told him to move along, he complied without further issues.

Response call from Joe & Jon's: intoxicated male harassing customers inside and outside. Approached the intoxicated male and told him not to harass people; he apologised and left without further issues.
Response call from Britomart McDonald's: vagrant sleeping at the front of the store. Spoke to the vagrant, who left without further issues.
Standby maintaining presence at Commercial Bay.
Arrived back at HQ charging Ops Phone (low).
Arrived at High St; full sweep of Freyberg Square / Chancery Square complete, no issues.
Arrived at Fort St; welfare checks on stores, all clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart. Standby for presence.
Arrived at corner of ANZ Queen St; standby for issues/vagrants.
Afternoon shift complete; handover to night shift.
